name: com.anlyon/anlyon
title: Anlyon
description: Governed production actions and human approvals for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: ANLYON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anlyon API key (Workspace Settings, API Keys). Its scopes decide what the tools can do.

environmentVariables.name: ANLYON_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API origin, for a non-production Anlyon API. Defaults to https://api.anlyon.com.

environmentVariables.name: ANLYON_END_USER
environmentVariables.description: Act for one of your users: every call carries Anlyon-End-User with this id, so actions use that user's own connected accounts. Set by your server, never by the model.
